{{Quote|Free the beasts!|The beast master calls for Boneshatter and the other creatures to be released|audio=Beastmaster-FreeTheBeasts.flac|<ref name="House Cleaning" />}}
'''Boneshatter''', who bore the epithet '''the Rampager''', was a [[wraid]] [[Nem'ro's gang|owned]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] who kept it in the beast pit of his [[Nem'ro's Palace|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="House Cleaning" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> Nem'ro sent a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] who was seeking the Hutt's sponsorship for the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] competition to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Suudaa Nem'ro's beast master|beast master]] that cared for Boneshatter, claiming that he was a traitor.<ref name="House Cleaning" />

Nem'ro warned the beast master that the hunter was coming, so the beast master prepared Boneshatter and several other creatures to attack the hunter. Once the hunter arrived, the beast master began releasing the creatures while Nem'ro watched. After the hunter slew the [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]] [[Clawbane]], the beast master released Boneshatter and two [[Akk dog/Legends|Akk pups]], but the hunter managed to slay them all, and ultimately the beast master himself. Nem'ro congratulated the hunter on killing Boneshatter and the other beasts. The wraid had [[Color/Legends|yellow]] skin and white [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="House Cleaning" />

==Behind the scenes==
Boneshatter appeared as a non-optional enemy in "House Cleaning," a quest in the bounty hunter class campaign in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively-multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="House Cleaning" />
